_about: Clutch timing. Half-widths in ms around the cue: Nice is about a quarter second wide in total, TOTALLY RAD about a tenth. Stats never change these; only the modifiers below do (Wide Windows setting, Defend, Butterfingers, Fired Up).

parry._about: Action-combat parry (CS-7). One-sided: only a press BEFORE contact counts, so these are how early it may be. Scaled live by the parry_window_scale feel knob.
